findings.title: Add return type hints to Python handlers
findings.description: Project rule R-12 requires Python functions to carry parameter and return type hints. This new handler has no return annotation, and the same omission appears across the new server handlers and helpers, leaving their return contracts unspecified.

findings.title: Whisper inference blocks the sidecar event loop
findings.description: `do_transcribe` performs synchronous model loading and inference, but this call runs directly inside an `async` request handler. While it runs, the single Uvicorn event loop cannot serve health checks, generation polling, or other requests; `/transcribe-path` makes the same direct call. Run the inference in a worker thread, as the generation and YouTube paths already do for blocking work.

findings.title: Declare sidecar request bodies as typed models
findings.description: Project rule R-11 requires request bodies and query parameters to use typed models or typed parameters, and forbids handlers from reading raw untyped dictionaries. This handler reads audio_path from a generic dict, so malformed or unexpected request bodies bypass the declared request contract; the same pattern is used by other JSON handlers in this file.

findings.quote:
@app.post("/generate")
async def generate(request: dict):
    """Start voice generation. Returns immediately with a generation ID."""
    profile_id = request.get("profile_id", "")
    text = request.get("text", "")
    language = request.get("language", "en")
findings.title: Voice generation and chunking have no regression test
findings.description: The new /generate path loads Qwen, combines voice samples, splits long text, generates and concatenates audio, and records asynchronous status, but the added binary smoke script never calls /generate, its status endpoint, or the audio endpoint, and no automated tests exercise these paths or the chunking utilities. A regression in the central voice-cloning flow (including long-text handling or failures during generation) can therefore pass the current CI tests unnoticed. Add focused tests around the generation lifecycle and chunk splitting/concatenation, using controlled model/audio boundaries so they do not require downloading multi-gigabyte models.

findings.title: Generation records and audio files accumulate indefinitely
findings.description: Each generation adds a permanent entry to the process-wide `_generations` dictionary, and completed audio is saved under `DATA_DIR/generations` without an expiry or cleanup path. Repeated voice tests and recordings therefore grow both memory and app-data disk usage for the lifetime of the sidecar, eventually making the app consume unbounded storage. Expire completed and failed records and remove their associated files once they are no longer needed.

findings.title: CWE-918: YouTube extraction accepts arbitrary server-side URLs
findings.description: The extraction endpoint takes the `url` field from the request and passes it directly to yt-dlp without checking its scheme, hostname, or resolved addresses. The create-voice UI forwards the user-entered `youtubeUrl` to this endpoint, so a crafted URL can make the local sidecar issue requests to loopback, private-network, or link-local services from the user's machine. Restrict input to supported YouTube hosts and reject URLs that resolve to non-public addresses before downloading (including redirect destinations).

findings.title: Non-English local profiles always generate as English
findings.description: When a user creates a local profile in another language, the recording pipeline still sends `language: en`; the sidecar passes that value to Qwen generation instead of using the profile's stored language. Thus recordings using supported non-English profiles are synthesized with the wrong language setting.

findings.title: Validate the frontend path before proxying it
findings.description: Project rule R-07 requires Tauri commands to validate every path, URL, and identifier received from the frontend before use. sidecar_fetch concatenates the supplied path directly into the local sidecar URL, so callers can make the command request arbitrary sidecar routes without validation.

findings.title: Model downloads time out in the voice setup flow
findings.description: The create-voice screen calls `VoiceboxClient.downloadModel`, which routes `/models/download` through `sidecar_fetch`. That endpoint streams its completion event only after `snapshot_download` finishes, while this proxy buffers the whole response under a 30-second timeout; downloads of the multi-gigabyte models therefore fail in normal use before the wizard can advance.

findings.title: Duplicate model status proxy logic
findings.description: This command repeats the sidecar startup, GET request, HTTP error handling, and response parsing already implemented by `local_tts::check_model_status` in the same change. Keeping both implementations means timeout and error behavior can drift while both commands expose the same model status. Share a private fetch helper between the commands, or keep one status command and update its callers.

findings.title: Model downloads bypass their typed Tauri command
findings.description: The frontend still reaches the sidecar's model-download endpoint through the generic path/method proxy, while the change adds and registers `models::download_model` as the model-specific Tauri boundary with channel progress events. This leaves two competing command paths for model downloads and prevents the frontend flow from using the typed progress contract. Route this method through `download_model` and remove the duplicate low-level download path so the model API has one owner.

findings.title: Release the retry timer on component teardown
findings.description: Project rule R-04 requires every timer created by a component to be released in a cleanup path. This timeout is not retained or cleared by onDestroy, so it can call the IPC loader after the page has been destroyed.

findings.title: Do not silently swallow the sidecar load failure
findings.description: Project rule R-05 requires IPC awaits to report failures or rethrow, and forbids empty catch blocks. If loading voices fails, this handler silently leaves the local voice list empty, making an unavailable sidecar appear like an account with no voices.
